title: LitSoc (inter-hostel culturals)
summary: Sangam clubs, the LitSoc championship, Queen of Sheba and other events.

posts.md:
College life at IIT Madras is enriched by a vibrant cultural scene facilitated by **Sangam**, a conglomeration of about **16 activity clubs**.

Students can participate in a wide range of cultural activities, including:

- Dance
- Music
- Classical Arts
- Drama
- Fashion
- Writing
- Oratory
- Fine Arts
- Comedy
- E-Sports
- Quizzing
- Word Games
- Media
- Design & VFX
- And many more.

## What is LitSoc?

**LitSoc (Literary Society)** is the year-long **inter-hostel cultural championship** at IIT Madras.

Hostels compete against each other throughout the academic year in a variety of cultural events, earning points to compete for the **LitSoc Cup**.

Although LitSoc originally consisted only of literary competitions, it has grown over the years to include a wide range of cultural events across multiple disciplines.

## Events & Competitions

Around **40 events** are conducted every year as part of LitSoc.

The competition begins with **Queen of Sheba**, a flagship event that combines a **treasure hunt** with a celebration of hostel spirit.

The competitions continue throughout both semesters:

- **Odd Semester:** More individual events
- **Even Semester:** More group events

Some of the most popular LitSoc events include:

- Queen of Sheba
- Hostel Choreo Night
- Short Film Making & Screening
- Band Performances
- And many more.

Winners receive **certificates and medals**, and events are judged by experts from outside the institute.

Outstanding performances have even led to opportunities for students to perform outside the institute.

## Hostel Bonding Through LitSoc

LitSoc is more than just a competition—it is an important part of the hostel experience.

Students who may not have known each other often come together to represent their hostel, building friendships while competing for valuable points.

Information about events is shared through:

- Club Instagram pages
- Sangam Instagram pages
- Official student emails
- Event posters and rulebooks

Freshers who actively participate throughout LitSoc are also recognized with **special awards** for contributing points to their hostel.

## Why LitSoc?

LitSoc encourages students to explore new forms of art, develop their talents, and step outside their comfort zones.

It offers opportunities to:

- Try new cultural activities
- Earn participation and competition points
- Cheer for your hostel during events
- Celebrate your hostel's achievements

For many students, watching their hostel lift the **LitSoc Championship Trophy** is one of the most memorable moments of campus life.

The friendships, experiences, and hostel spirit built during LitSoc become lasting memories long after graduation.
